_comment: Corrects recipe yields where db.ascension.gg disagrees with the game.
Fused foods    -- the database claims 10, the game makes 1.  Overridden.
Distilled flasks -- the database claims 3, and the game makes 3.  NOT
overridden: an earlier guess that flasks were wrong the same way foods
were turned out to be false, and it understated flask revenue threefold.
The field is read correctly; it is simply wrong for the Fused foods. Vanilla
recipes (Major Healing Potion, Flask of the Titans, Smoked Desert Dumplings)
all report creates=[id,1,1], which is how the parsing was checked.
Yield multiplies revenue directly, so anything added here should be confirmed
in game rather than inferred from a sibling recipe.
To correct one: add "<item_id>": <count> under by_item. by_item wins over
by_family. Remove a family entry to accept whatever the database reports.
